agent.name: Emerging Technology Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Contextual adoption posture and decision triggers

analytical_question: What adoption action is appropriate now for the retailer's weekly reporting application?
general_et_finding: Generative AI has demonstrated useful assistance in some work settings but task-dependent errors and uneven effects across users (S1-S2). This supports testing a specified human-AI workflow, not a universal maturity or adoption label. S4 reports 40.54550% U.S. employed-adult work use in Q3 2026, below Q2; this is neither retail-task prevalence nor local value. Current capability of the unnamed model remains unverified.
application_finding: The weekly narrative task has a plausible fit: verified aggregates provide a factual reference and drafts can be checked. Relative advantage remains unknown after review/correction effort. Manual templates and deterministic BI summaries are viable alternatives. Unsupported causal explanations or wrong figures could distort management decisions, so factual fidelity matters more than polished prose.
organization_specific_finding: PROOF OF CONCEPT is appropriate first because the sole changed fact is a conservative posture that prefers fixed archived evidence before prospective workflow learning. The technology is neither less capable nor less mature. Approved evaluation access and reviewers remain assumed; exact model, cost cap and protocol still need approval before execution.

evidence.claim: Study of 5,172 customer-support agents reports 15% average increase in issues resolved per hour; effects differ across workers.
evidence.notes: Historical single-firm customer-support setting; not current retail-reporting accuracy, a local ROI forecast or a vendor/model guarantee. Use final publication, not 2023 working-paper figures of 5,179 and 14%.

evidence.claim: Randomized study of 758 consultants found task-dependent gains and harm. On one outside-frontier task, combined AI groups were approximately 19 percentage points less likely to be correct.
evidence.date_or_recency: 2026-03-11 online; experiment used June 2023 GPT-4; checked 2026-11-01
evidence.notes: A single difficult task in an earlier model setting; not a universal error rate for 2026 tools. Body specifies percentage points; avoid treating the abstract wording as a relative percentage.

evidence.claim: Voluntary guidance supports empirical capability evaluation, deployment-relevant testing and limits on extrapolation from narrow assessments.
evidence.notes: Risk-management guidance, not law, a compliance certificate, or proof that the hypothetical organization is ready. Numerical experiment gates below are analyst proposals, not NIST thresholds.

evidence.claim: Q3 2026: 40.54550% of U.S. employed adults aged 18-64 report using generative AI for work; Q2: 45.19932%.
evidence.date_or_recency: Updated 2026-10-20; observations Q3 2026 and Q2 2026; checked 2026-11-01
evidence.notes: Self-reported workers, not retail firms or the reporting task. Not seasonally adjusted; not retained-user cohorts, local benefit, or an automatic adopter-category threshold. Data may be revised.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: The cases and controls are hypothetical intake assumptions; no actual retailer performance or approval is established.
S1 is customer support, and S2 used an earlier model with a single outside-frontier task. Neither estimates this retailer's effect.
Peer diffusion for this task is unknown; worker adoption does not establish firm/task penetration or retention.
Four weeks with six analysts would be a small, repeated-measures study. Learning, task mix and selection can affect findings.
The 10% gate and four-week horizon are analyst proposals requiring sponsor approval, not thresholds from the cited research.
confidence_and_uncertainty: Moderate confidence in the conditional learning posture given the hypothetical intake; low confidence in net local benefit, current model task capability or production readiness. Historical studies and a small future trial cannot settle those questions. No pilot has been executed.
value_opportunity_implication: The strongest driver is the option to resolve local net-value uncertainty through reversible learning. Compare total person-minutes per completed report and incremental costs against manual and deterministic alternatives. Existing license expenditure is not evidence that further spending is worthwhile.
risk_governance_implication: Treat approved non-sensitive evaluation access and assigned reviewers as intake assumptions, not a readiness certificate. Manual reports remain authoritative, experimental drafts stay quarantined and no AI-generated output triggers inventory changes. The Organizational Adoption Agent must assess ownership continuity, training, data stewardship, support capacity and sustainable funding before implementation. IT/data owner verifies the actual tool route and data scope.
recommendation_management_implication: PROOF OF CONCEPT: plan a fixed offline evaluation of approved archived aggregate tables with known reference values, including missing values, contradictory figures and requests for unsupported explanations. Sponsor: analytics manager; oversight: two reviewers and IT/data owner. All six analysts should contribute so feasibility is not judged only by experts. Record factual errors, ability to abstain, and checking effort against manual/deterministic summaries. Confirm model identity, bounded cost and approved protocol before running; if not approved, DEFER execution. Keep outputs outside business decisions. Review by 30 November 2026. Adequate fidelity and manageable review effort may justify a subsequent shadow experiment; this PoC cannot establish recurring organizational value or justify rollout.
change_monitoring_triggers: Planning-to-launch gate: analytics sponsor and IT/data owner confirm tool identity, allowed non-sensitive data, reviewer availability, quarantine, fallback, resource cap and metrics. If any required approval is missing, do not launch.

Transition from PROOF OF CONCEPT to considering BOUNDED EXPERIMENT only if archived-case factual fidelity and abstention are acceptable to the sponsor, review effort is feasible and an approved live-shadow protocol exists. Record failed edge cases as well as successful examples. The primary experiment's proposed 10% effort gate belongs to comparative value testing, not proof of technical feasibility.

Pause on unauthorized data exposure, critical error surviving review, an unreviewed draft escaping quarantine, lost oversight or budget breach. Revert to manual, investigate and reauthorize before restarting.

By 30 November 2026 assess evidence available, even if delayed launch means fewer than four weeks. Do not declare success merely because the date arrives. If inconclusive, consider only justified bounded further learning; if net value is negative, favor the simpler alternative.

Operational adoption would require representative repeatable net value, acceptable errors, verified controls and Organizational Adoption clearance beyond this small study. A material model, data, workflow or use-scope change triggers reassessment.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Record the exact tool/model version, confirm applicable data handling and the approved dataset before any run; no vendor capability, price or legal compliance is asserted.
Sponsor must approve resource/cost cap, task allocation and acceptance criteria. Planning may proceed, but execution is withheld until these are confirmed; unavailable approvals mean DEFER.
Need representative local quality/effort/cost evidence and Organizational Adoption readiness assessment before any ADOPT recommendation.
